selection_rule: Use the current upstream-maintained public benchmark version whose licence permits evaluation. The deprecated LongMemEval Hugging Face dataset is not eligible when the upstream-maintained cleaned replacement exists.

deprecated_dataset_excluded.reason: upstream dataset card marks it deprecated and replaced by longmemeval-cleaned

freeze_semantics.version_identity: exact upstream commit/revision, not a moving main branch
freeze_semantics.hash_identity: Git commit/tree/blob identity for code plus Hugging Face snapshot revision and upstream SHA-256 checksums where published
freeze_semantics.future_upstream_changes: ignored for this campaign unless this freeze is prospectively superseded before any protected evaluation; after protected evaluation begins, no version substitution is allowed
freeze_semantics.materialization_check: before execution, download exactly the frozen dataset revision and require all published per-file hashes to match; any mismatch is CANNOT_CHECK_VERSION_BINDING
freeze_semantics.licence_check: MIT for LongMemEval cleaned and Apache-2.0 for LongMemEval-V2 at the frozen public sources
